chunks.title: DMRC HR Compendium — Document Overview
chunks.content: The DMRC HR Compendium (Updated November 2023) is a 356-page document covering all HR policies for Delhi Metro Rail Corporation employees. It has 13 chapters: Chapter A — General Conditions of Service Rules (pages 1-48); Chapter B — Conduct, Discipline and Appeal Rules (pages 49-85); Chapter C — Pay and Allowances Rules (pages 86-119); Chapter D — Travelling Allowance/Daily Allowance Rules (pages 120-134); Chapter E — Medical Attendance Rules (pages 135-164); Chapter F — Leave Rules (pages 165-186); Chapter G — House Building Advance Rules (pages 187-276); Chapter H — Recruitment Rules (pages 277-288); Chapter I — Vehicle Advance Rules (pages 289-299); Chapter J — Multi-Purpose Advance Rules (pages 300-310); Chapter K — Housing Allotment Rules (pages 311-328); Chapter L — Staff Welfare Fund Rules (pages 329-340); Chapter M — Leave Travel Concession Rules (pages 341-352).

chunks.title: DMRC Leave Types — Complete List (13 Types)
chunks.content: DMRC provides 13 types of leave under Chapter F of the HR Compendium: (1) Casual Leave — 8 days/year (5-day office) or 12 days/year (6-day O&M field); (2) Special Casual Leave — up to 30 days/year for specific approved purposes; (3) Earned Leave — 30 days/year, max 300 days accumulated; (4) Half Pay Leave — 20 days/year, salary at 50%; (5) Leave Not Due — medical grounds only, max 360 days career; (6) Commuted Leave — medical or approved study, charged at double HPL; (7) Extra Ordinary Leave — no other leave due, max 2 years career, no pay; (8) WRIIL — job-related illness/injury, full pay during hospitalization and 6 months post; (9) Quarantine Leave — infectious disease in household, max 21 days; (10) Maternity Leave — 182 days for up to 2 children, 12 weeks for more than 2; (11) Paternity Leave — 15 days for male employees with less than 2 children; (12) Child Care Leave — 730 days in career for confirmed female employees; (13) Study Leave — after 3 years service, max 24 months career, MD approval.

chunks.title: DMRC Financial Limits — All Advances Quick Reference
chunks.content: DMRC Financial Advances and Limits Quick Reference: HBA — New house/flat: Rs.40 lakh or 60x basic pay (lower) (Interest: 5%/7.5%/9% (slab), Chapter G); HBA — Enlargement: Rs.20 lakh or 60x basic pay (lower) (Interest: 9%, Chapter G); HBA Cost Ceiling: 139x basic pay; max Rs.1 Crore (Interest: N/A, Chapter G); Motor Car Advance — Executive: Rs.5 lakh or 25x monthly basic (lower); vehicle ceiling Rs.15L (Interest: As per rules, Chapter I); Motor Car Advance — Sr. Supervisor: Rs.3.5 lakh or 25x monthly basic (lower); vehicle ceiling Rs.9L (Interest: As per rules, Chapter I); Motor Car Advance — Supervisor/below: Rs.1.5 lakh or 25x monthly basic (lower); vehicle ceiling Rs.6.75L (Interest: As per rules, Chapter I); Two-Wheeler Advance — All grades: Rs.1.5 lakh or 10x monthly basic (lower); vehicle ceiling Rs.1.5L (Interest: As per rules, Chapter I); Multi-Purpose Advance (MPA): Rs.2 lakh or 5x basic pay (lower) (Interest: 7.5% simple, Chapter J); EL Encashment on superannuation: 300 days (EL+HPL combined) (Interest: N/A, Chapter F); EL Encashment on resignation: 50% non-encashable EL; max 75 days (Interest: N/A, Chapter F); CTG on transfer (>20km): 80% of last month basic pay (Interest: N/A, Chapter D); CTG on transfer (<20km/same city): 1/3rd of CTG (Interest: N/A, Chapter D)

chunks.title: DMRC Master Authority Index — Who Approves What
chunks.content: DMRC Approval Authorities — Who Approves What: All rule interpretations and relaxations: Managing Director (Chapter All (A-M)); Superannuation extension beyond age 60: Board of Directors (Chapter A); EOL sanction for non-supervisors (1st time): HOD (Chapter F); EOL sanction for supervisors/execs up to Manager: Director (Chapter F); EOL sanction for Dy.HOD and above: Managing Director (Chapter F); Study Leave sanction: Managing Director (Chapter F); WRIIL approval (non-exec): HOD (Chapter F); WRIIL approval (exec): Director (Chapter F); Ex-India leave ≤10 days (Non-exec/AM/Manager): HOD (Chapter F); Ex-India leave >10 days (AM/Manager); any duration (Dy.HOD/HOD): Director (Chapter F); HBA sanction for executives: Director (Finance) (Chapter G); HBA cost ceiling relaxation (up to 25%): Sanctioning Authority (Chapter G); Vehicle advance for executives: Director (Finance) (Chapter I); Vehicle advance for non-executives (O&M): GM/O&M/HR (Chapter I); Vehicle advance for non-executives (Project/Corporate): ED/HR (Chapter I); MPA sanction (Project/Corporate): HOD/HR (Chapter J); MPA sanction (O&M): HOD/HR/O&M (Chapter J); Quarter allotment: Estate Officer (Chapter K); Staff Welfare Fund allocation: Committee → Managing Director (Chapter L); Change of Home Town (LTC): MD / Functional Director (Chapter M); Split LTC approval: HOD (Chapter M); Major penalties (dismissal/removal/compulsory retirement): As per Schedule A, Chapter B (Chapter B); Minor penalties (censure/withholding increment etc.): As per Schedule A, Chapter B (Chapter B); Prolonged medical treatment (non-exec): HOD (Chapter E); Prolonged medical treatment (exec): Director (Chapter E); Suspension of employee: Competent Authority (Chapter B)

chunks.title: Chapter A — General Conditions of Service Rules — Summary
chunks.content: Chapter A — General Conditions of Service: (1) Employee Classification: Non-Executive (Unskilled Rs.16000-50000 to Sr.Supervisor-I Rs.50000-160000); Executive (AM Rs.50000-160000 to MD Rs.200000-370000); 18 grades total. (2) Appointment: 6 modes — Direct Recruitment, Deputation, Absorption, Post-Retirement Contractual, Lateral Induction, Compassionate; min age 18, max 28. (3) Probation: 2 years for Non-Executive/AM/Manager; 1 year for DGM and above. (4) Surety Bond: 3 years for all direct recruits; training cost recoverable on early exit. (5) Resignation: minimum 90-day notice. (6) Assets & Liabilities: Annual submission by 31st March; prior permission for transactions >2 months gross salary. (7) APAR: 5 grades — Outstanding, Very Good, Good, Average, Below Average; 2 consecutive Below Average = adverse action. (8) Training: DMRA conducts induction training; report within 30 days of return. (9) Higher Studies: After 3 years service (2 years for DGM+); correspondence/part-time only; NOC from HR. (10) Transfer: Anywhere in DMRC; max 6 days joining time. (11) Holidays: 2 Restricted Holidays/year + 3 compulsory National Holidays. (12) VRS: After 20 years service or age 50; 3-month notice. (13) Service Review: At age 50 and 55; compulsory retirement possible with 3-month notice. (14) Superannuation: Age 60, last day of birth month. (15) Lien on deputation: Maximum 3 years.

chunks.title: Chapter B — Conduct, Discipline and Appeal Rules — Summary
chunks.content: Chapter B — Conduct, Discipline and Appeal Rules: (1) Applicability: All regular employees; excludes casual, contract, PRCE, consultant. (2) General Conduct: Absolute integrity, devotion to duty, no acts unbecoming of public servant; zero tolerance for sexual harassment. (3) Misconduct (24 acts): theft/fraud (5.1), bribery (5.2), disproportionate assets (5.3), false information (5.4), willful insubordination (5.6), absence >4 days without explanation (5.7), habitual late attendance (5.8), sleeping on duty (5.16), criminal offense (5.17), sexual harassment (5.22), non-disclosure of foreign visits within 2 weeks (5.23), subletting staff quarters (5.24). (4) Suspension: With subsistence allowance — 50% pay first 90 days, 75% beyond 90 days; review committee mandatory before extension. (5) Penalties: Minor — censure, withholding increment/promotion, recovery of loss; Major — reduction in pay, compulsory retirement, removal, dismissal. (6) Disciplinary Proceedings: Charge sheet → inquiry officer → inquiry report → action. (7) Appeals: To Appellate Authority within 45 days.

chunks.title: Chapter C — Pay and Allowances Rules — Summary
chunks.content: Chapter C — Pay and Allowances: (1) Pay Scales (IDA, w.e.f. 01.01.2017): 18 grades from Unskilled Rs.16000-50000 to MD Rs.200000-370000. (2) Dearness Allowance: IDA pattern, revised quarterly on AICPI. (3) Perks: Cafeteria approach; maximum ceiling 31.5% of basic pay. (4) HRA: X-class cities 27%, Y-class 18%, Z-class 9% of basic pay; not payable if DMRC quarters occupied. (5) Transport: Vehicle to eligible grades; transport allowance to others. (6) Night Duty Allowance (NDA): O&M non-executives on roster duty; max 18 nights/month. (7) Hard Duty/Kilometrage Allowance: O&M field staff based on km covered; revised 01.12.2019. (8) Consolidated Daily Allowance: Project employees. (9) TADK Reimbursement: Eligible executive grades. (10) Leased Accommodation: Grade-wise lease ceilings. (11) Mobile/Laptop: Eligible grades. (12) Honorarium for D&AR enquiry. (13) Briefcase purchase: Executive entitlement. (14) Conveyance/refreshment for working beyond hours/holidays. (15) Shifting Allowance on transfer. (16) Higher Qualification Incentive. (17) Foreign Pay & Allowances. (18) PRCE consolidated fee. (19) Special Allowance: DMRA staff, Vigilance. (20) Birthday Gift. (21) Subsistence Allowance during suspension.

chunks.title: Chapter D — Travelling Allowance / Daily Allowance (TA/DA) Rules — Summary
chunks.content: Chapter D — TA/DA Rules: (1) Applicability: All regular employees, probationers, re-employed, deputationists; not casual/contract unless specifically extended by MD. (2) Travel Entitlement: MD/TMM — Air (domestic highest/intl. first class); ED/CGM — Air (domestic highest/intl. business); HODs Rs.120000-280000 — Air Y-class/intl. business/AC-1 Rail; Rs.70000-200000 — Air Economy/1st AC; Rs.50000-160000 Exec — Air Economy/2nd AC; Rs.35000-110000 — First Class/Rajdhani 3rd AC; Rs.25000-80000 — First Class/AC 3-Tier; Below Rs.25000-80000 — 2nd Sleeper. (3) Daily Allowance (A1 cities): MD/TMM Rs.1400/day; ED/CGM/SGM/GM Rs.1200/day; DGM-AGM Rs.1000/day; Manager/AM Rs.900/day; Rs.25000-80000 to highest non-exec Rs.800/day; Below Rs.25000-80000 Rs.500/day. Proportional: ≤6 hrs = 30%; 6-12 hrs = 70%; >12 hrs = 100%. Halt beyond 30 days = 50% DA; beyond 90 days = 50% with HOD approval. Meals: free breakfast = -25% DA; all 3 meals = -50% DA. Composite TA (own arrangement) = 50% more than normal TA. (4) Hotel Charges (X-class, excl. taxes): MD actual; ED/CGM Rs.10000; GM Rs.9000; DGM-AGM Rs.6800; Manager/AM Rs.4500; Rs.25000-80000+ Rs.2300; Below Rs.25000-80000 Rs.1700. Y/Z class: proportionally lower. (5) Composite Transfer Grant (CTG): 80% of last month basic pay for transfer >20km; 1/3rd for <20km/same city. Address proof required. (6) Transportation of personal effects: MD/Directors — 8000 kg @Rs.50/km; Rs.37000-115000+ — 6000 kg @Rs.50/km; Rs.35000-80000 and below — 1500 kg @Rs.15/km. (7) TA advance: up to 90% of estimated expenditure; settle within 30 days; 10% p.a. interest on delay. (8) Local journey: Rs.120000-280000+ AC Taxi; Rs.50000-160000 Exec Taxi; Rs.25000-80000 Three-Wheeler; Below Bus.

chunks.title: Chapter E — Medical Attendance Rules — Summary
chunks.content: Chapter E — Medical Attendance Rules: (1) Applicability: All regular employees and specified family (spouse, children <25/employed; unmarried unemployed daughter; dependent parents income <15% basic or Rs.9000+DR). (2) Empanelled Hospitals: DMRC-empanelled hospitals in Delhi/NCR for cashless; government hospitals also accepted. (3) IPD Room Entitlement: MD/Directors — Suite/Deluxe (Nursing Home/NH rates); ED/HoDs — Deluxe (NH rates); Sr.AGM/AGM/JGM/Sr.DGM — Single Room (SNH rates); DGM/Manager/AM/Sr.Supervisor — Single Room (SNH rates); Supervisors — Two/Three bedded (SP rates); Non-Supervisors — Economy/General Ward (SP rates). (4) Cashless Treatment: At empanelled hospitals; certificate within 7 days of discharge. (5) Prolonged Treatment: HOD approval (non-exec); Director approval (exec); medicine bills max 2 months at a time. (6) Family declaration: Required at time of joining. (7) Medical claim deadline: Within 6 months of incurring expense. (8) Pre/Post hospitalization: 30 days before and 60 days after hospitalization reimbursed.

chunks.title: Chapter F — Leave Rules — Summary
chunks.content: Chapter F — Leave Rules: DMRC provides 13 types of leave: (1) Casual Leave (CL): 8 days/yr (5-day office) or 12 days/yr (6-day O&M/field); cannot carry over; not combinable with EL/HPL; pro-rata on joining/separation. (2) Special Casual Leave (SCL): Up to 30 days/yr; for sports, blood donation (max 4/yr), sterilization, elections, PWD (4 extra days + 10 for seminars), staff council, scouts, bandh/curfew. (3) Earned Leave (EL): 30 days/yr; 15 on 1 Jan + 15 on 1 Jul; Encashable (max 150 days) + Non-Encashable; total max 300 days; max at one time 120 days (180 outside India); encashable once/yr after 2 years service; leave salary = full pay including DA and perks. (4) Half Pay Leave (HPL): 20 days/yr; no accumulation limit; max at one time 24 months; salary = 50% pay. (5) Leave Not Due (LND): Medical grounds; after 1 year service; max 360 days career (180 days at once); charged against future HPL; refund if resigned/dismissed before clearing. (6) Commuted Leave: On medical grounds or approved study; charged 2x HPL; paid at EL rate; max 90 days for study (= 180 HPL). (7) Extra Ordinary Leave (EOL): No other leave due; after 6 years service; max 2 years career (6 months per 5 years); no pay; no EL/HPL/increment; deemed resignation after EOL expiry; no private employment. (8) WRIIL: Job-related illness/injury; full pay during hospitalization + 6 months; half pay next 12 months; no EL/HPL credited. (9) Quarantine Leave: Infectious disease in household; max 21 days (30 exceptional); full salary; combinable. (10) Maternity Leave: 182 days (26 weeks) for ≤2 children; 12 weeks for >2 children; 45 days miscarriage; 180 days child adoption (child <1 year, <2 children); full pay; not charged to leave account. (11) Paternity Leave: 15 days; <2 children; within 15 days before or 6 months after delivery; full pay; not charged. (12) Child Care Leave (CCL): Confirmed female employees; 2 years service min; 730 days (2 years) entire career; child <18; max 3 spells/yr (6 for single); min 5 days/spell; full pay; bond required if <5 years service. (13) Study Leave: After 3 years service; MD sanction; max 12 months at once (24 months special); max 24 months career; full pay + HRA (180 days) + CCA (120 days); bond required; counts for seniority/promotion. (14) Leave Encashment: 300 days (EL+HPL) on superannuation/death; 50% non-encashable EL (max 75 days) on resignation; once/year during service after 2 years. (15) Compensatory Rest: O&M non-executives only; max 3 days; within 30 days.

chunks.title: Chapter G — House Building Advance (HBA) Rules — Summary
chunks.content: Chapter G — House Building Advance (HBA): (1) Title: DMRC 'Own Your Own House' Advance Rules. (2) Eligibility: Regular confirmed employees only; excludes deputationists, ad-hoc, temporary, re-employed, contract, daily-wage. (3) Purpose: New construction, purchase of new house/flat, enlargement of existing house (after 5 years of possession; only Delhi/NCR). (4) Cost Ceiling: 139 times basic pay, maximum Rs.1 Crore (excluding land); relaxable up to 25% on merits. (5) HBA Amount: New house/flat — 60 times basic pay or Rs.40 lakh, whichever less. Enlargement — 60 times basic pay or Rs.20 lakh (minus amount already availed), whichever less; only after 5 years; not if superannuating in 36 months; interest @9%. (6) Take-home: Minimum 50% of basic pay + DA must remain after all deductions. (7) Interest Rates: ≤Rs.12 lakh: 5% p.a.; Rs.12-25 lakh: 7.5% p.a.; >Rs.25 lakh: 9% p.a. (simple interest). (8) Repayment: Principal in max 240 monthly installments; must complete before superannuation; house mortgaged to DMRC. (9) Enlargement disbursement: 3 installments (25%+50%+25%). (10) Loan Swapping: Existing home loans from banks can be migrated to HBA once during service. (11) Insurance: Property must be insured throughout loan period. (12) Penalty: Rs.500/month for delay in submitting original title deed.

chunks.title: Chapter H — Recruitment Rules — Summary
chunks.content: Chapter H — Recruitment Rules (DMRC Recruitment Rules 2021): (1) Posts: Executive (AM and above up to ED); Non-Executive (Unskilled to Sr. Section Engineer/Station Manager level). (2) Recruitment Modes: Direct Recruitment, Deputation, Absorption, PRCE, Lateral Induction, Compassionate Appointment. (3) Direct Recruitment: Written test/interview; age min 18, max 28 (entry-level); SC/ST/OBC/PWD/ESM relaxation as per GoI; character verification mandatory; medical fitness mandatory; DMRA induction training mandatory; 3-year surety bond. (4) Campus Recruitment: From premier institutions for executive-level posts. (5) PRCE: For retired employees on fixed-term contract; consolidated fee; not eligible for most service benefits (no EL, HBA, Vehicle Advance, MPA, CCL). (6) Absorption: Deputationists with tripartite consent (DMRC + parent dept + employee) and vacancy availability. (7) Contract Regularization: As per DMRC policy after fulfilling conditions. (8) Compassionate Appointment: For dependent of deceased/incapacitated employee; Screening Committee; min age 18. (9) Probation: 2 years (Non-Exec/AM/Manager); 1 year (DGM+).

chunks.title: Chapter I — Vehicle Advance Rules — Summary
chunks.content: Chapter I — Vehicle Advance Rules (DMRC 'Own Your Own Vehicle' Advance Rules): (1) Objective: Advance for purchase of NEW vehicles only (no used vehicles); for official use. (2) Eligibility: Regular confirmed employees; 2.5 years service; minimum 3 years remaining before superannuation; excludes deputation/temporary/ad-hoc/re-employed/contract; contract service @70% after regularization. (3) Motor Car Advance: Supervisors and below (≤Rs.37000-115000): Rs.1.5 lakh or 25 months basic pay; vehicle ceiling Rs.6.75 lakh. Sr. Supervisors (Rs.40000-125000 to Rs.50000-160000 non-exec): Rs.3.5 lakh or 25 months basic pay; ceiling Rs.9 lakh. Executives (Rs.50000-160000+): Rs.5 lakh or 25 months basic pay; ceiling Rs.15 lakh. (4) Two-Wheeler Advance: All grades — Rs.1.5 lakh or 10 months basic pay; ceiling Rs.1.5 lakh. (5) Sanctioning Authority: Director(F) for executives; ED/HR for non-executives in Project/Corporate; GM/O&M/HR for non-executives in O&M. (6) Prior Intimation: Mandatory before purchase via ESS (movable property under Conduct Rules); no post-facto approval. (7) Documents required: 6-month bank statement, quotation, loan papers, source of funds. (8) Bonds: Mortgage Form Rs.50, Agreement Rs.50, Insurance Rs.50, Surety Bonds (2 x Rs.100).

chunks.title: Chapter J — Multi-Purpose Advance (MPA) Rules — Summary
chunks.content: Chapter J — Multi-Purpose Advance (MPA): (1) Objective: For emergent financial needs — marriage/social functions, education, house furnishing, electronics, domestic contingencies. (2) Eligibility: Confirmed employees with 2.5 years service and more than 3 years remaining before superannuation; excludes temporary, ad-hoc, daily-rated, re-employed, contract; contract service @70% after regularization. Fresh cases prioritized. (3) Amount: Maximum Rs.2,00,000 or 5 times basic pay, whichever is less. (4) Frequency: Max 3 occasions in entire career; next MPA only after 2 years from complete repayment of previous MPA. (5) Interest: 7.5% simple interest; principal recovered in max 30 installments; interest in max 5 installments after that; total recovery cap: 50% of pay. (6) Surety: 1 surety for MPA ≤Rs.50,000; 2 sureties for >Rs.50,000; surety must be confirmed equivalent/higher grade with 3 years remaining. (7) Sanctioning Authority: HOD/HR for Project/Corporate; HOD/HR/O&M for O&M division. (8) Documents: Surety bonds (non-judicial stamp paper Rs.20 each), ESS application printout.

chunks.title: Chapter K — Housing Allotment Rules — Summary
chunks.content: Chapter K — Housing Allotment Rules: (1) Locations: DMRC staff quarters at 12 locations — Ajronda, Bahadurgarh, Gurgaon, Mukundpur, Mundka, Najafgarh, New Ashok Nagar, Sarita Vihar, Shastri Park, Vinod Nagar, Yamuna Bank and Noida. (2) Eligibility: All regular employees including probationers; excludes casual, re-employed, deputationist, contract. (3) No Right: No employee has right to DMRC accommodation; subject to availability. (4) Occupancy: As licensees — DMRC retains ownership. (5) Types: 7 types — Type-II Transit Flats (1 BHK) for all grades up to Rs.35000-110000 (non-supervisor); higher types for higher grades. (6) HRA: Not payable while in DMRC quarters; employee forgoes HRA. License fee payable monthly. (7) Subletting: Strictly prohibited; = misconduct under Conduct Rules B.5.24; damages (penal rent) charged for unauthorized subletting/occupation. (8) Essential Quota: Quarters allotted to operational staff required near duty point. (9) Priority List: Grade-wise waiting list; quarterly Open-for-All allotment. (10) Retention: Must vacate within 1 month of transfer/superannuation/resignation/removal. (11) Mutual Change: Permitted with Estate Officer approval. (12) Own house: Employees with own house at current station not eligible. (13) Employees on CCL/Study Leave may retain quarters.

chunks.title: Chapter L — Staff Welfare Fund Rules — Summary
chunks.content: Chapter L — Staff Welfare Fund Rules: (1) Members: Regular and contract employees on regular pay scale; excludes deputationists, PRCE, consultants, daily-wage, apprentices. (2) Family: Same as medical/LTC — spouse, children (son <25/unmarried employed; unmarried unemployed daughter), dependent parents (income <15% basic or Rs.9000+DR). (3) Fund Sources: (a) Monthly member contributions; (b) Voluntary donations; (c) Interest on investments/charity shows; (d) DMRC annual matching contribution (equal to previous year's member contributions, credited in April). (4) Management Committee: Nominated by MD — HOD-level Chairman, Dy.HOD Deputy Chairman, Dy.HOD Member-Secretary, 2 employee representatives (one exec, one non-exec); tenure 2 years. (5) Welfare Activities: (a) General — marriage gift (member + first 2 children), child birth gift (first 2 children), disabled/Divyangjan child grant, one-time grant to family of deceased member (where no compassionate appointment), sports excellence cash award (state/national/intl.), women empowerment grants; (b) Education — 10th/12th qualification grant (one-time), first-time admission grant, Tablet PC for one daughter (non-supervisor grade), professional degree completion cash award for daughters; (c) Recreation — sports, cultural, picnics, clubs, educational tours; (d) Sickness/Distress — terminal disease financial aid, artificial limbs, funeral expenses (member + spouse + children). (6) Fund Allocation: Proposed by Committee, approved by MD. (7) Accounts: Separate; audited annually; signed by 2 members (Chairman + Secretary joint signatures for disbursement).

chunks.title: Chapter M — Leave Travel Concession (LTC) Rules — Summary
chunks.content: Chapter M — Leave Travel Concession (LTC) Rules: (1) Applicability: Regular employees + contractual on regular pay scale with min 1 year service; absorbed deputationists; excludes casual, retired re-employed, short-term contract. (2) LTC Types: (a) Home Town LTC: once per 2-year block; direct/shortest route hometown and back; (b) All-India LTC: once per 4-year block; anywhere in India and back. If All-India LTC not availed in 4-year block: one extra Hometown LTC allowed. Employees with same hometown and headquarters: not eligible for Hometown LTC. (3) Block Years: 4-year blocks — 2014-17, 2018-2022, 2023-2025, etc. Min 6-month gap between LTCs. (4) Home Town: Declared at joining; change allowed once during career (MD/Functional Director). (5) Travel Entitlement: Non-Supervisors (Rs.16000-50000): 2nd Sleeper; Rs.20000-60000 to Rs.35000-110000: 1st Class/AC 3-Tier; Supervisor/lower execs: AC 2-Tier/Rajdhani 3rd AC/Shatabdi CC/AC Bus; Upper execs: 1st AC / Air Economy; GM+: Air Domestic Highest; MD/Directors: Air Highest. (6) Incidental Charges (All-India LTC only): Non-supervisors Rs.3750; Supervisors Rs.5250; Executives below HOD Rs.6000; HOD and above Rs.9000. (7) LTC Advance: Up to 90% of estimated fare; settle within 30 days; 10% p.a. interest on delay. (8) Special LTC (NER/J&K/A&N/Ladakh): Non-executives can travel by Air (Economy) on specific sectors against conversion of one Home Town LTC; extended till 25.09.2024 (DoPT); tickets booked min 21 days advance via authorized agents. (9) Split LTC: Employee and family can travel separately; HOD approval required. (10) LTC during CCL: Permitted.

chunks.title: Rule A.1: Classification of Employees
chunks.content:
Rule A.1 — Classification of Employees (Chapter A: General Conditions of Service Rules)
Applies to: all employees
Non-Executive grades: Unskilled 16000-50000, Semi-skilled 20000-60000, Skilled Maintainer 25000-80000, Maintainers & Assistants 35000-110000, Supervisor-II 37000-115000, Supervisor-I 40000-125000, Sr.Supervisor-II 46000-145000, Sr.Supervisor-I 50000-160000. Executive grades: AM 50000-160000, Manager 60000-180000, DGM 70000-200000, Sr.DGM 80000-220000, JGM 90000-240000, AGM 100000-260000, GM/Sr.GM/CGM 120000-280000, ED 150000-300000, Director 180000-340000, MD 200000-370000. GM/CGM entitled to special pay Rs.2500/month.
Key points: 18 grades total; Two categories: Non-Executive and Executive; GM/CGM special pay Rs.2500/month; Board-level officers may have different appointment terms
Amounts/Limits: Rs.16000-50000 to Rs.200000-370000
Approval Authority: Board of Directors

chunks.title: Rule A.2: Appointment
chunks.content:
Rule A.2 — Appointment (Chapter A: General Conditions of Service Rules)
Applies to: all employees
6 modes: Direct Recruitment, Deputation, Absorption, Post-Retirement Contractual, Lateral Induction, Compassionate. Age: min 18, max 28 (entry-level). Medical fitness from DMRC-nominated hospital mandatory (valid 6 months). Surety Bond 3 years; training cost recoverable on early exit. Min notice for resignation: 90 days.
Key points: 6 intake modes; Age: min 18, max 28 for direct recruit; Medical fitness mandatory; Probation: 2 yrs (Non-Exec/AM/Mgr), 1 yr (DGM+); Surety bond: 3 years; Min notice: 90 days
Amounts/Limits: Min age 18; Max age 28; Probation 1-2 years; Notice 90 days
Approval Authority: Managing Director

metadata.amounts_or_limits: Min age 18; Max age 28; Probation 1-2 years; Notice 90 days

chunks.title: Rule A.5: Performance Appraisal (APAR)
chunks.content:
Rule A.5 — Performance Appraisal (APAR) (Chapter A: General Conditions of Service Rules)
Applies to: all employees
Annual APAR mandatory (April–March). Grades: Outstanding, Very Good, Good, Average, Below Average. Two consecutive Below Average ratings = adverse action. Three-tier: Self-appraisal → Reporting Officer → Reviewing Officer.
Key points: APAR mandatory annually; 5 rating grades; 2 consecutive Below Average = adverse action; 3-tier appraisal process
Approval Authority: Reviewing Officer / HOD

chunks.title: Rule A.6: Assets and Liabilities
chunks.content:
Rule A.6 — Assets and Liabilities (Chapter A: General Conditions of Service Rules)
Applies to: all employees
Annual statement of assets (immovable property, shares, cash, insurance etc.) submitted by 31st March. Non-submission = misconduct. Prior permission required for transactions exceeding 2 months gross salary.
Key points: Deadline: 31st March annually; Non-submission = misconduct; Prior permission for transactions > 2 months gross salary
Amounts/Limits: Threshold: 2 months gross salary
Approval Authority: Competent Authority

chunks.title: Rule A.8: Holidays
chunks.content:
Rule A.8 — Holidays (Chapter A: General Conditions of Service Rules)
Applies to: all employees
2 Restricted Holidays per year from declared list. 3 compulsory National Holidays: Republic Day (26 Jan), Independence Day (15 Aug), Gandhi Jayanti (2 Oct). Annual holiday list notified by HR.
Key points: 2 Restricted Holidays per year; 3 compulsory National Holidays; List notified annually by HR
Amounts/Limits: 2 Restricted Holidays per year
Approval Authority: HR Department

chunks.title: Rule A.9: Transfer
chunks.content:
Rule A.9 — Transfer (Chapter A: General Conditions of Service Rules)
Applies to: all employees
Transfer is administrative exigency; employees liable for transfer anywhere in DMRC. Must comply within joining time (max 6 days). Transfer expenses reimbursed as per TA/DA rules.
Key points: Transfer anywhere in DMRC jurisdiction; Max 6 days joining time; Expenses reimbursed per TA/DA rules
Amounts/Limits: Max 6 days joining time
Approval Authority: Competent Authority / Functional Director

chunks.title: Rule A.14: Resignation
chunks.content:
Rule A.14 — Resignation (Chapter A: General Conditions of Service Rules)
Applies to: all employees
Minimum 90-day notice. Payment in lieu of notice possible. Surety bond amount and training cost recoverable if resignation within 3 years of joining. Withdrawal permitted before acceptance.
Key points: Min 90-day notice; Surety bond + training cost recoverable within 3 years; Withdrawal permitted before acceptance
Amounts/Limits: 90-day minimum notice
Approval Authority: Competent Authority

chunks.title: Rule A.19: Service Review at Age 50/55
chunks.content:
Rule A.19 — Service Review at Age 50/55 (Chapter A: General Conditions of Service Rules)
Applies to: all employees
Service reviewed at age 50 and 55 by a Committee. Unsatisfactory performance may lead to compulsory retirement in public interest with 3-month notice or pay in lieu. No stigma — not a disciplinary proceeding.
Key points: Review at age 50 and 55; 3-month notice for compulsory retirement; No stigma attached
Amounts/Limits: 3-month notice
Approval Authority: Review Committee / Board

chunks.title: Rule A.20: Voluntary Retirement
chunks.content:
Rule A.20 — Voluntary Retirement (Chapter A: General Conditions of Service Rules)
Applies to: all employees
VRS after 20 years qualifying service or age 50. 3-month notice or pay in lieu. Pension/gratuity payable on VRS.
Key points: Eligible: 20 years service or age 50; 3-month notice (or pay in lieu); Pension/gratuity payable
Amounts/Limits: 20 years service or age 50; 3-month notice
Approval Authority: Competent Authority

chunks.title: Rule A.22: Superannuation
chunks.content:
Rule A.22 — Superannuation (Chapter A: General Conditions of Service Rules)
Applies to: all employees
Retirement at age 60, last day of the month in which employee turns 60. No extension beyond 60 except for specialized posts with Board approval. NOC and departmental clearance mandatory.
Key points: Age 60; last day of birth month; No extension without Board approval; NOC and clearance mandatory
Amounts/Limits: Age 60
Approval Authority: Board of Directors (for extension)

chunks.title: Rule B.5: Misconduct
chunks.content:
Rule B.5 — Misconduct (Chapter B: Conduct, Discipline and Appeal Rules)
Applies to: all regular employees
24 specific acts of misconduct including: theft/fraud, bribery, disproportionate assets, false information at appointment, willful insubordination, absence without leave >4 consecutive days, habitual late attendance, neglect of work, sleeping on duty, criminal offense involving moral turpitude, sexual harassment at workplace, non-disclosure of private foreign visits within 2 weeks, subletting staff quarters.
Key points: Absence >4 consecutive days without explanation = misconduct; Non-disclosure of foreign visits within 2 weeks = misconduct; Subletting quarters = misconduct; Sexual harassment = misconduct; 24 specific acts listed
Amounts/Limits: Absence threshold: 4 consecutive days
Approval Authority: Disciplinary Authority

chunks.title: Rule B.37: Suspension
chunks.content:
Rule B.37 — Suspension (Chapter B: Conduct, Discipline and Appeal Rules)
Applies to: all regular employees
Employee may be placed under suspension when disciplinary proceedings contemplated, case of moral turpitude under investigation, or continued presence prejudicial to inquiry. Review committee mandatory before extension beyond 90 days.
Key points: Pending disciplinary proceedings; Review mandatory before 90-day extension; Suspension reviewed every 90 days
Amounts/Limits: Review before 90-day extension
Approval Authority: Competent Authority

chunks.title: Rule B.38: Subsistence Allowance
chunks.content:
Rule B.38 — Subsistence Allowance (Chapter B: Conduct, Discipline and Appeal Rules)
Applies to: suspended employees
During suspension: first 90 days — 50% of pay + DA; beyond 90 days (if not employee's fault for delay) — 75% of pay + DA; if suspension set aside — full pay (notional).
Key points: First 90 days: 50% pay + DA; Beyond 90 days: 75% pay + DA; Exonerated: full pay
Amounts/Limits: 50% (first 90d) / 75% (beyond 90d)
Approval Authority: Disciplinary Authority

chunks.title: Rule B.40: Penalties
chunks.content:
Rule B.40 — Penalties (Chapter B: Conduct, Discipline and Appeal Rules)
Applies to: all regular employees
Minor Penalties: (i) Censure; (ii) Withholding increment with cumulative effect; (iii) Withholding promotion; (iv) Recovery of pecuniary loss. Major Penalties: (v) Reduction to lower pay stage; (vi) Reduction to lower post; (vii) Compulsory retirement; (viii) Removal (eligible for re-employment); (ix) Dismissal (not eligible for re-employment).
Key points: 4 minor penalties; 5 major penalties; Dismissal = barred from re-employment; Removal = not barred from re-employment
Approval Authority: Disciplinary Authority (Schedule A)

chunks.title: Rule B.50: Appeals
chunks.content:
Rule B.50 — Appeals (Chapter B: Conduct, Discipline and Appeal Rules)
Applies to: all regular employees
Employee can appeal against penalty order to Appellate Authority (per Schedule A) within 45 days. Appellate authority may confirm, modify, or set aside the penalty.
Key points: 45-day appeal window; Appellate authority as per Schedule A; Can confirm, modify or set aside
Amounts/Limits: 45 days to appeal
Approval Authority: Appellate Authority (Schedule A)

chunks.title: Rule C.1: Pay Scales (IDA)
chunks.content:
Rule C.1 — Pay Scales (IDA) (Chapter C: Pay and Allowances Rules)
Applies to: all employees
IDA pay scales w.e.f. 01.01.2017. Range: Unskilled Rs.16000-50000 to MD Rs.200000-370000. Sr. AGM designation and Rs.2500/month special allowance after 3 years at AGM level with satisfactory APAR.
Key points: IDA pattern w.e.f. 01.01.2017; 18 grades; Sr.AGM: Rs.2500/month after 3 years at AGM
Amounts/Limits: Rs.16000-50000 to Rs.200000-370000
Approval Authority: Board
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/2927/2019 dated 03.12.2019

chunks.title: Rule C.3: Perks
chunks.content:
Rule C.3 — Perks (Chapter C: Pay and Allowances Rules)
Applies to: all employees
Cafeteria approach — employee selects components within ceiling. Maximum ceiling: 31.5% of basic pay.
Key points: Cafeteria approach; Max ceiling: 31.5% of basic pay
Amounts/Limits: Max 31.5% of basic pay
Approval Authority: HR Department
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/1486/2014 dated 24.09.2014, O.O. No. PP/2534/2018 dated 09.01.2018

chunks.title: Rule C.4: House Rent Allowance (HRA)
chunks.content:
Rule C.4 — House Rent Allowance (HRA) (Chapter C: Pay and Allowances Rules)
Applies to: all employees
HRA rates: X-class 27%, Y-class 18%, Z-class 9% of basic pay. Not payable if DMRC staff quarters are occupied.
Key points: X-class: 27% of basic pay; Y-class: 18% of basic pay; Z-class: 9% of basic pay; Not payable if in DMRC quarters
Amounts/Limits: 27% / 18% / 9% of basic pay
Approval Authority: Finance Department
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/2072/2015 dated 15.03.2022, O.O. No. PP/2647/2018 dated 27.09.2018

chunks.title: Rule C.7: Night Duty Allowance
chunks.content:
Rule C.7 — Night Duty Allowance (Chapter C: Pay and Allowances Rules)
Applies to: O&M non-executive employees
NDA for O&M non-executives performing roster duty with night shifts. Maximum 18 nights per month.
Key points: O&M non-executives only; Max 18 nights per month; Based on reporting timing
Amounts/Limits: Max 18 nights per month
Approval Authority: O&M HOD
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP-2925/2019 dated 03.12.2019

chunks.title: Rule D.6: Mode of Travel Entitlement on Tour
chunks.content:
Rule D.6 — Mode of Travel Entitlement on Tour (Chapter D: Travelling Allowance / Daily Allowance (TA/DA) Rules)
Applies to: all regular employees
Travel entitlement by grade: MD/TMM: Air Domestic Highest, Intl. First Class. ED/CGM: Air Domestic Highest, Intl. Business. HODs (Rs.120000-280000): Air Y-class/Intl. Business, Rail AC-1. Rs.70000-200000 to <Rs.120000: Air Economy, Rail 1st AC. Rs.50000-160000 Exec: Air Economy, Rail 2nd AC. Rs.35000-110000: Rail First Class/Rajdhani 3rd AC, AC Bus. Rs.25000-80000: Rail First Class/AC 3-Tier, AC Bus. Below Rs.25000-80000: Rail 2nd Sleeper, Ordinary Bus. GM with basic Rs.175000+ entitled to Business Class air.
Key points: 8 grade-wise travel categories; Air travel from Rs.50000-160000 Exec and above; GM with basic Rs.175000+: Business Class; TA advance up to 90%; settle within 30 days
Approval Authority: Controlling Officer
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP-2925/2019 dated 03.12.2019

chunks.title: Rule D.7: Daily Allowance Rates
chunks.content:
Rule D.7 — Daily Allowance Rates (Chapter D: Travelling Allowance / Daily Allowance (TA/DA) Rules)
Applies to: all regular employees
DA for A1 cities: MD/TMM Rs.1400/day; ED/CGM/SGM/GM Rs.1200/day; DGM/Sr.DGM/JGM/AGM Rs.1000/day; Manager/AM Rs.900/day; Rs.25000-80000 to highest non-exec Rs.800/day; Below Rs.25000-80000 Rs.500/day. Proportional: ≤6hrs=30%; 6-12hrs=70%; >12hrs=100%. First 30 days: full DA. 30-90 days: 50%. Beyond 90 days: 50% (HOD approval). Composite TA (own arrangement) = 50% more than normal DA.
Key points: MD: Rs.1400/day; Lowest: Rs.500/day; Hours-based: 30%/70%/100%; Beyond 30 days continuous: 50% DA; Free breakfast: -25%; All meals: -50%
Amounts/Limits: Rs.500-1400/day
Approval Authority: Controlling Officer
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP-2925/2019 dated 03.12.2019, O.O. No. PP-1801/2014 dated 02.07.2014

chunks.title: Rule D.7.3: Hotel Charges
chunks.content:
Rule D.7.3 — Hotel Charges (Chapter D: Travelling Allowance / Daily Allowance (TA/DA) Rules)
Applies to: all regular employees
Hotel charges (X-class cities, exclusive of taxes): MD actual; ED/CGM Rs.10000; GM Rs.9000; DGM/Sr.DGM/JGM/AGM Rs.6800; Manager/AM Rs.4500; Rs.25000-80000+ Rs.2300; Below Rs.25000-80000 Rs.1700. Y&Z class: ED/CGM Rs.8000; GM Rs.7200; DGM-AGM Rs.5500; Manager/AM Rs.3600; Rs.25000-80000+ Rs.1700; Below Rs.25000-80000 Rs.1400.
Key points: X-class higher ceilings; Y/Z class lower; Exclusive of taxes; MD: actual expenses
Amounts/Limits: Rs.1400 to Rs.10000 (X-class)
Approval Authority: HOD
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP-2925/2019 dated 03.12.2019, O.O. No. PP-3254/2023 dated 03.03.2023

chunks.title: Rule D.8: Transfer Entitlement
chunks.content:
Rule D.8 — Transfer Entitlement (Chapter D: Travelling Allowance / Daily Allowance (TA/DA) Rules)
Applies to: all employees on transfer
CTG: 80% of last month basic pay (transfer >20km); 1/3rd of CTG (transfer <20km or same city/NCR) with address proof. Transportation of personal effects: MD/Directors: 8000kg/4-wheeler wagon @Rs.50/km; Rs.37000-115000+: 6000kg @Rs.50/km; Rs.35000-80000 and below: 1500kg @Rs.15/km.
Key points: CTG: 80% of last basic pay (>20km); CTG: 1/3rd for <20km/same city; Address proof mandatory for CTG; Personal effects transport: Rs.15-50/km
Amounts/Limits: CTG: 80% of last basic pay; Transport: Rs.15-50/km
Approval Authority: Controlling Officer / Director
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/2715/2019 dated 07.01.2019

metadata.amounts_or_limits: CTG: 80% of last basic pay; Transport: Rs.15-50/km

chunks.title: Rule E.family: Family Definition (Medical)
chunks.content:
Rule E.family — Family Definition (Medical) (Chapter E: Medical Attendance Rules)
Applies to: all employees
Family for medical: Spouse; Son (below 25 or till married/employed, whichever earlier); Unmarried daughter (not employed, dependent); Parents residing with employee whose combined income does not exceed 15% of basic pay or Rs.9000 plus DR, whichever more.
Key points: Spouse: always covered; Son: below 25 or till employed/married; Unmarried daughter: till employed; Parents: income < 15% basic or Rs.9000+DR
Amounts/Limits: Parent income threshold: 15% of basic or Rs.9000+DR
Approval Authority: HR Department

metadata.amounts_or_limits: Parent income threshold: 15% of basic or Rs.9000+DR

chunks.title: Rule E.ipd: IPD Room Entitlement
chunks.content:
Rule E.ipd — IPD Room Entitlement (Chapter E: Medical Attendance Rules)
Applies to: all employees
Room entitlement during hospitalization: MD/Directors: Suite/Deluxe (NH); ED/HoDs: Deluxe (NH); Sr.AGM/AGM/JGM/Sr.DGM: Single Room (SNH); DGM/Manager/AM/Sr.Supervisor: Single Room (SNH); Supervisors: Two/three bedded (SP); Non-Supervisors: Economy/General Ward (SP).
Key points: 6 grade-wise room categories; MD/Directors: Nursing Home (highest); Non-Supervisors: Economy/General Ward
Approval Authority: HR Department
Office Orders: O.O No. HR/O&M/196/2023 dated 17.05.2023

chunks.title: Rule E.cashless: Cashless Treatment
chunks.content:
Rule E.cashless — Cashless Treatment (Chapter E: Medical Attendance Rules)
Applies to: all employees
Cashless at DMRC-empanelled hospitals. Certificate (Annexure E) within 7 days of availing facility: total bill, employee payment, DMRC advance, net reimbursable. Medical claims must be submitted within 6 months.
Key points: Cashless at empanelled hospitals; Certificate within 7 days of discharge; Claims within 6 months
Amounts/Limits: Certificate: 7 days; Claims: 6 months
Approval Authority: HR / Finance

chunks.title: Rule E.prolonged: Prolonged Treatment
chunks.content:
Rule E.prolonged — Prolonged Treatment (Chapter E: Medical Attendance Rules)
Applies to: all employees
Prior approval required: HOD for non-executives; Director for executives. Medicine bills reimbursed for max 2 months at a time. Employee must submit declaration and doctor's prescription.
Key points: Prior approval mandatory; HOD (non-exec) / Director (exec); Medicine bills: max 2 months at a time
Amounts/Limits: Medicine bills: max 2 months at once
Approval Authority: HOD (non-exec) / Director (exec)

metadata.amounts_or_limits: Medicine bills: max 2 months at once

chunks.title: Rule F.3.1: Casual Leave (CL)
chunks.content:
Rule F.3.1 — Casual Leave (CL) (Chapter F: Leave Rules)
Applies to: all employees
CL for urgent/unforeseen situations. Office (5-day week): 8 days/year. O&M/Field (6-day week): 12 days/year. Half or full days. Cannot carry over. Sundays/holidays in CL spell not charged. Not combinable with EL/HPL. Applied via ESS. Pro-rata on joining/separation.
Key points: Office: 8/yr; O&M/Field: 12/yr; Cannot carry over to next year; Not combinable with EL or HPL; Pro-rata on joining or separation
Amounts/Limits: 8 days/yr (office) or 12 days/yr (O&M)
Approval Authority: Controlling Officer
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/43/99 dated 14.12.1999, O.O. No. PP/1525/2012 dated 14.11.2012

chunks.title: Rule F.3.2: Special Casual Leave (SCL)
chunks.content:
Rule F.3.2 — Special Casual Leave (SCL) (Chapter F: Leave Rules)
Applies to: all employees
SCL up to 30 days/year total. Purposes: scouts/guides camps, Republic Day events, sports tournaments, Court attendance, technical meetings, sterilization (vasectomy: 5 days; tubectomy female: 10 days; male for wife's tubectomy: 3 days; female for husband's vasectomy: 1 day), bandh/curfew, staff council, PWD employees (4 extra days + 10 days for conferences), blood donation (max 4 times/year, 1 day each), elections. Combinable with EL or CL but not both simultaneously.
Key points: Max 30 days/year; Blood donation: max 4 times/year; PWD: 4 extra days + 10 for conferences; Sterilization: 1-10 days based on type; Combinable with EL or CL (not both)
Amounts/Limits: Max 30 days/year
Approval Authority: HOD
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/2553/2018 dated 20.03.2018

chunks.title: Rule F.3.3: Earned Leave (EL)
chunks.content:
Rule F.3.3 — Earned Leave (EL) (Chapter F: Leave Rules)
Applies to: all regular/temporary employees, deputationists
30 days/year credited half-yearly (15 on 1 Jan + 15 on 1 Jul). Two accounts: Encashable (max 150 days) and Non-Encashable; overall max 300 days. Max at one time: 120 days (180 outside India). New joinee: 2.5 days/month. Leave salary: full pay including perks and DA. PRCE: 1 special leave per completed month. On superannuation/death: encashment up to 300 days (EL+HPL combined). EL credit reduced by 1/10th of EOL in previous half-year.
Key points: 30 days/yr (15 on 1-Jan + 15 on 1-Jul); Encashable max 150 days; Total max 300 days; Max at one time: 120 days (180 outside India); Leave salary: full pay including DA and perks; PRCE: 1 special leave per completed month
Amounts/Limits: 30 days/yr; Max 300 days accumulated
Approval Authority: Controlling Officer / HOD
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/872/2009, O.O. No. PP/2300/2016, O.O. No. PP/1788/2014 dated 06.06.2014

chunks.title: Rule F.3.4: Half Pay Leave (HPL)
chunks.content:
Rule F.3.4 — Half Pay Leave (HPL) (Chapter F: Leave Rules)
Applies to: all employees
20 days/year (10 on 1 Jan + 10 on 1 Jul). No accumulation limit. Max at one time: 24 months. Leave salary: 50% of pay + DA.
Key points: 20 days/yr; No accumulation limit; Max at one time: 24 months; Leave salary: 50% of pay
Amounts/Limits: 20 days/yr; max 24 months at once
Approval Authority: Controlling Officer / HOD

chunks.title: Rule F.3.5: Leave Not Due (LND)
chunks.content:
Rule F.3.5 — Leave Not Due (LND) (Chapter F: Leave Rules)
Applies to: regular employees after 1 year service
LND on medical grounds only; no other leave (except CL) available. After 1 year service. Max 360 days career (max 180 days at once). Charged against future HPL. Leave salary same as HPL (50%). If resigned/dismissed/died before earning requisite HPL: refund required. No medical cert needed for LND after Maternity Leave, for adoptive mother, or after CCL.
Key points: Medical grounds only (usually); After 1 year service; Max 360 days career; max 180 days at once; Charged against future HPL; No medical cert after maternity/adoption/CCL
Amounts/Limits: Max 360 days career; max 180 days at once
Approval Authority: Competent Authority

metadata.amounts_or_limits: Max 360 days career; max 180 days at once

chunks.title: Rule F.3.6: Commuted Leave
chunks.content:
Rule F.3.6 — Commuted Leave (Chapter F: Leave Rules)
Applies to: all employees
Commuted leave on medical grounds or approved course of study in Corporation's interest. Charged at double HPL but paid at full EL salary rate. Max for study course: 90 days (= 180 HPL days). Female on adoption: 60 days without medical cert. No medical cert in continuation of maternity leave.
Key points: Charged 2x HPL; paid at EL salary; Medical grounds or approved study; Max for study: 90 days (=180 HPL); Female adoption: 60 days without medical cert
Amounts/Limits: Max 90 days for study
Approval Authority: Competent Authority / HOD

chunks.title: Rule F.3.7: Extra Ordinary Leave (EOL)
chunks.content:
Rule F.3.7 — Extra Ordinary Leave (EOL) (Chapter F: Leave Rules)
Applies to: regular employees after 6 years service
EOL only when no other leave due or employee applies specifically. After 6 years qualifying service. Max 2 years in entire career; proportionate: 6 months per 5 years service. Sanctioning authority: HOD (non-supervisor, 1st time; extensions to Director); Directors (supervisor/exec up to Manager); MD (Dy.HOD and above). No pay, no EL/HPL/increment earned, not counted for qualifying service. Deemed resignation if absent after EOL expiry. No private employment during EOL. All cases routed through HR.
Key points: After 6 years service; Max 2 years career (6 months per 5 years service); No pay; no leave earning; no increment; Deemed resignation after EOL expiry; No private employment during EOL; All cases through HR
Amounts/Limits: Max 2 years career; 6 months per 5 years service
Approval Authority: HOD (non-supervisor) / Director (supervisor/exec up to Manager) / MD (Dy.HOD+)
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/1917/2015 dated 06.02.2015

metadata.approval_authority: HOD (non-supervisor) / Director (supervisor/exec up to Manager) / MD (Dy.HOD+)
metadata.amounts_or_limits: Max 2 years career; 6 months per 5 years service

chunks.title: Rule F.3.8: Work Related Illness and Injury Leave (WRIIL)
chunks.content:
Rule F.3.8 — Work Related Illness and Injury Leave (WRIIL) (Chapter F: Leave Rules)
Applies to: all employees — permanent and temporary
WRIIL for illness/injury attributable to or aggravated by official duties. Provisions: (a) Full pay during entire hospitalization; (b) Full pay for 6 months post-hospitalization; (c) Half pay for next 12 months (commutable to full pay with HPL debit); (d) No EL/HPL credited during WRIIL. Approval: HOD (non-exec), Director (exec). Applied via ESS with Incident Report (Annexure V).
Key points: Full pay during hospitalization; Full pay 6 months post-hospital; Half pay next 12 months; No EL/HPL credited during WRIIL; Incident Report mandatory (Annexure V)
Amounts/Limits: Full pay: hospital + 6 months; Half pay: 12 months beyond
Approval Authority: HOD (non-exec) / Director (exec)
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/3227/2022 dated 03.11.2022, O.O. No. HR/O&M/361/2022 dated 15.12.2022

metadata.amounts_or_limits: Full pay: hospital + 6 months; Half pay: 12 months beyond

chunks.title: Rule F.3.9: Quarantine Leave
chunks.content:
Rule F.3.9 — Quarantine Leave (Chapter F: Leave Rules)
Applies to: all employees
Quarantine leave when infectious disease (cholera, plague, diphtheria, typhus, meningitis, conjunctivitis etc.) is present in employee's family/household. Employee himself suffering: other leaves apply, not quarantine. Max 21 days (up to 30 days exceptional with AMA/Public Health Officer certificate). Salary not affected. Combinable with other leaves.
Key points: For infectious disease in HOUSEHOLD — not employee personally; Max 21 days ordinary; 30 days exceptional; Full salary unaffected; Combinable with other leaves
Amounts/Limits: Max 21 days (30 exceptional)
Approval Authority: Controlling Officer

chunks.title: Rule F.3.10: Maternity Leave
chunks.content:
Rule F.3.10 — Maternity Leave (Chapter F: Leave Rules)
Applies to: female regular employees, deputationists, long-term contractual on regular pay scale
(a) Up to 2 children: 182 days (26 weeks); max 8 weeks before expected delivery. (b) More than 2 surviving children: 12 weeks; max 6 weeks before delivery. Miscarriage/abortion (any number of children): 45 days with medical cert. Child adoption: 180 days for child <1 year (employee with <2 children). Any leave except CL combinable without medical cert. Full pay; not charged to leave account.
Key points: 182 days (26 weeks) for ≤2 children; 12 weeks for >2 children; 45 days for miscarriage/abortion; 180 days child adoption (child <1 yr, <2 children); Full pay; not charged to leave account
Amounts/Limits: 182 days (≤2 children); 12 weeks (>2 children); 45 days (miscarriage)
Approval Authority: Competent Authority / HOD
Office Orders: O.O. No. HR/O&M-140/2022 dated 25.04.2022, O.O. No. PP/820/2008, O.O. No. PP/1955/2015 dated 26.03.2015

applies_to: long-term contractual on regular pay scale

chunks.title: Rule F.3.11: Paternity Leave
chunks.content:
Rule F.3.11 — Paternity Leave (Chapter F: Leave Rules)
Applies to: male employees with fewer than 2 surviving children
15 days during confinement/childbirth. Condition: less than 2 surviving children. Full salary; not charged to leave account. Combinable with any leave except CL. Availed within 15 days before or 6 months after delivery. Also 15 days on valid adoption of child below 1 year within 6 months of adoption.
Key points: 15 days; for employees with <2 children; Within 15 days before or 6 months after delivery; Full pay; not charged to account; Also 15 days on adoption (child <1 yr)
Amounts/Limits: 15 days
Approval Authority: Controlling Officer / HOD
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/807/2008 dated 15.09.2008, O.O. No. PP/1955/2015 dated 26.03.2015

applies_to: male employees with fewer than 2 surviving children

chunks.title: Rule F.3.12: Child Care Leave (CCL)
chunks.content:
Rule F.3.12 — Child Care Leave (CCL) (Chapter F: Leave Rules)
Applies to: confirmed regular female employees with min 2 years service
Max 730 days (2 years) entire career. For children below 18 (or disabled child any age with min 40% disability). Max 3 spells/year (6 for single employees); min 5 days/spell. Full pay; no cafeteria perks. Not charged to leave account. Bond required if <5 years service (serve DMRC for 3 years after return). Not available to contract/PRCE/consultant. LTC can be availed during CCL.
Key points: Confirmed female employees; min 2 years service; 730 days (2 years) career; Child <18 (any age if disabled 40%+); Max 3 spells/yr (6 for single); min 5 days/spell; Bond required if <5 years service; Not for contract/PRCE/consultant
Amounts/Limits: Max 730 days career; min 5 days per spell
Approval Authority: Competent Authority / HOD
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/820/2008, O.O. No. PP/847/2008, O.O. No. PP/1009/2009, O.O. No. PP/1326/2011, O.O. PP/1987/2015 dated 22.05.2015

applies_to: confirmed regular female employees with min 2 years service
metadata.amounts_or_limits: Max 730 days career; min 5 days per spell

chunks.title: Rule F.3.13: Study Leave
chunks.content:
Rule F.3.13 — Study Leave (Chapter F: Leave Rules)
Applies to: regular employees with 3+ years service, absorbed deputationists
For scientific, technical or managerial studies in Corporation's interest. After 3 years service. MD is sanctioning authority. Max 12 months at one time (24 months in special circumstances); max 24 months in entire career. Not granted if retiring within 3 years of return. Leave salary: full pay + DA + HRA (first 180 days) + CCA (first 120 days). Bond required. On resignation within 3 years of return: refund of leave salary + fees + interest. Counts for promotion, seniority, increment, PF.
Key points: After 3 years service; MD approval mandatory; Max 12 months at once (24 months max career); Leave salary: full pay + DA + HRA (180d) + CCA (120d); Bond mandatory; refund if resign within 3 years of return; Counts for seniority/promotion/increment
Amounts/Limits: Max 12 months at once; 24 months in career
Approval Authority: Managing Director
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/3139/2021 dated 26.10.2021

metadata.amounts_or_limits: Max 12 months at once; 24 months in career

chunks.title: Rule F.4: Leave Encashment
chunks.content:
Rule F.4 — Leave Encashment (Chapter F: Leave Rules)
Applies to: all regular employees
(a) Full EL+HPL up to 300 days on superannuation, premature retirement (non-disciplinary), death. (b) During service: encashable leave account only, once/year, after 2 years service; no upper per-transaction limit (subject to max 150 days encashable). (c) On resignation/quitting: 50% of non-encashable EL, max 75 days. (d) Disciplinary dismissal/removal: no encashment. (e) PRCE/contract: not eligible. Encashment amount: basic + special pay + DA (HRA/CCA not included).
Key points: Superannuation/death: full 300 days (EL+HPL); During service: once/year from encashable account; after 2 yrs service; Resignation: 50% non-encashable EL; max 75 days; Disciplinary dismissal: no encashment; PRCE/contract: not eligible; Amount: basic + DA (no HRA/CCA)
Amounts/Limits: Max 300 days on superannuation; max 75 days on resignation
Approval Authority: HR Department / Finance
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/798/2008 dated 28.08.2008

metadata.amounts_or_limits: Max 300 days on superannuation; max 75 days on resignation

chunks.title: Rule F.8: Compensatory Rest
chunks.content:
Rule F.8 — Compensatory Rest (Chapter F: Leave Rules)
Applies to: O&M non-executive employees only
Granted when O&M non-executive works on weekly rest day in emergency. Max 3 days at one time. Must be availed within 30 days. Can be prefixed/suffixed to leave, CL, Sundays, holidays.
Key points: O&M non-executives only; Max 3 days at one time; Must be availed within 30 days; Can prefix/suffix to leave or holidays
Amounts/Limits: Max 3 days; within 30 days
Approval Authority: O&M HOD
Office Orders: O.O. No. O&M/R&T-556 of 2004 dated 20.12.2004

chunks.title: Rule G.1: Eligibility
chunks.content:
Rule G.1 — Eligibility (Chapter G: House Building Advance (HBA) Rules)
Applies to: regular confirmed employees
HBA only to regular confirmed DMRC employees. Excludes deputationists, ad-hoc, temporary, re-employed, contract, daily-wage. Employee must not have availed govt. house scheme before; must not own house at work station.
Key points: Regular confirmed only; Excludes deputation, contract, temporary, PRCE; Cannot have prior govt. housing benefit
Approval Authority: Sanctioning Authority

chunks.title: Rule G.7: Cost Ceiling
chunks.content:
Rule G.7 — Cost Ceiling (Chapter G: House Building Advance (HBA) Rules)
Applies to: all HBA applicants
Ceiling (excluding land): 139 times basic pay, maximum Rs.1 Crore. Relaxable up to 25% on merits. If still exceeds after relaxation, employee must reduce scope.
Key points: Ceiling: 139x basic pay; max Rs.1 Crore; 25% relaxation possible; Excludes cost of land
Amounts/Limits: 139x basic pay; max Rs.1 Crore
Approval Authority: Sanctioning Authority
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/2752/2019 dated 30.01.2019

chunks.title: Rule G.8: Amount of Advance
chunks.content:
Rule G.8 — Amount of Advance (Chapter G: House Building Advance (HBA) Rules)
Applies to: all HBA applicants
New house/flat: min of (60x basic pay, Rs.40 lakh, cost, repaying capacity). Enlargement: min of (60x basic pay, Rs.20 lakh, cost of enlargement, repaying capacity) minus amount already availed; only after 5 years of possession; only Delhi/NCR; not if superannuating in 36 months; interest @9%.
Key points: New house: 60x basic or Rs.40 lakh (lower); Enlargement: 60x basic or Rs.20 lakh (lower); 5 years possession before enlargement; Delhi/NCR only for enlargement; Not if superannuating in 36 months
Amounts/Limits: New: max Rs.40 lakh; Enlargement: max Rs.20 lakh
Approval Authority: Director (Finance) / Sanctioning Authority
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/2752/2019 dated 30.01.2019, O.O. No. PP/1520/2012 dated 22.10.2012

metadata.amounts_or_limits: New: max Rs.40 lakh; Enlargement: max Rs.20 lakh

chunks.title: Rule G.9: Interest Rates
chunks.content:
Rule G.9 — Interest Rates (Chapter G: House Building Advance (HBA) Rules)
Applies to: all HBA borrowers
Simple interest from date of first disbursement. Slabs: ≤Rs.12 lakh: 5% p.a.; Rs.12-25 lakh: 7.5% p.a.; >Rs.25 lakh: 9% p.a. Enlargement HBA: 9% p.a. Take-home minimum: 50% of basic pay + DA after all deductions.
Key points: ≤Rs.12L: 5% p.a.; Rs.12-25L: 7.5% p.a.; >Rs.25L: 9% p.a.; Simple interest; Take-home min: 50% of basic+DA
Amounts/Limits: 5% / 7.5% / 9% p.a. (slab-based)
Approval Authority: Finance Department

chunks.title: Rule G.16: Repayment
chunks.content:
Rule G.16 — Repayment (Chapter G: House Building Advance (HBA) Rules)
Applies to: all HBA borrowers
Principal repaid in max 240 monthly installments. Recovery from salary. Must complete before superannuation. House mortgaged to DMRC until full repayment. Cannot sell/transfer without DMRC permission.
Key points: Max 240 installments; Must complete before superannuation; House mortgaged to DMRC throughout; No sale without DMRC permission
Amounts/Limits: Max 240 installments
Approval Authority: Finance Department

chunks.title: Rule H.5: Direct Recruitment
chunks.content:
Rule H.5 — Direct Recruitment (Chapter H: Recruitment Rules)
Applies to: new recruits
Open market recruitment via written test/interview. Age: min 18, max 28 for entry-level (SC/ST/OBC/PWD/ESM relaxation per Govt. guidelines). Medical fitness, character verification mandatory. 3-year surety bond. DMRA induction training mandatory.
Key points: Written test + interview; Age 18-28 (with reservations relaxation); Medical + character verification mandatory; 3-year surety bond; DMRA training mandatory
Amounts/Limits: Age 18-28
Approval Authority: Competent Authority / MD

chunks.title: Rule H.10: Post-Retirement Contractual Employment (PRCE)
chunks.content:
Rule H.10 — Post-Retirement Contractual Employment (PRCE) (Chapter H: Recruitment Rules)
Applies to: retired employees
PRCE on fixed-term contract; consolidated fee. Not eligible for EL, HBA, Vehicle Advance, MPA, CCL or most regular service benefits. Medical fitness required at engagement. Subject to organizational need and performance.
Key points: Fixed-term; consolidated fee; Not eligible for EL, HBA, Vehicle Advance, MPA, CCL; Medical fitness required; Subject to organizational need
Approval Authority: MD / Competent Authority

chunks.title: Rule H.14: Compassionate Appointment
chunks.content:
Rule H.14 — Compassionate Appointment (Chapter H: Recruitment Rules)
Applies to: dependents of deceased/incapacitated DMRC employees
For dependent (spouse or child) of DMRC employee who dies in harness or is permanently incapacitated medically. Subject to vacancy availability and Screening Committee recommendation. Min age 18; upper age may be relaxed. Governed by Govt. of India guidelines on reservation.
Key points: Dependent of deceased/incapacitated employee; Screening Committee approval required; Subject to vacancy availability; Min age 18
Amounts/Limits: Min age 18
Approval Authority: Screening Committee → MD

chunks.title: Rule I.2: Eligibility
chunks.content:
Rule I.2 — Eligibility (Chapter I: Vehicle Advance Rules)
Applies to: regular confirmed employees
Regular confirmed employees with 2.5 years service and min 3 years remaining before superannuation. New vehicles only. Contract service @70% after regularization. Excludes deputation, temporary, ad-hoc, re-employed, contract.
Key points: 2.5 years service + 3 years remaining; New vehicles only; Contract @70% after regularization
Amounts/Limits: Min 2.5 years; 3 years remaining
Approval Authority: Sanctioning Authority
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/1499/2012, O.O. No. PP/1987/2015, O.O. No. PP/1782/2014

chunks.title: Rule I.motor_car: Motor Car Advance Limits
chunks.content:
Rule I.motor_car — Motor Car Advance Limits (Chapter I: Vehicle Advance Rules)
Applies to: eligible employees
Supervisors/below (≤Rs.37000-115000): Rs.1.5 lakh or 25 months basic (ceiling vehicle Rs.6.75L). Sr. Supervisors (Rs.40000-125000 to Rs.50000-160000 non-exec): Rs.3.5 lakh or 25 months basic (ceiling Rs.9L). Executives (Rs.50000-160000+): Rs.5 lakh or 25 months basic (ceiling Rs.15L).
Key points: Supervisor: Rs.1.5L / Rs.6.75L ceiling; Sr. Supervisor: Rs.3.5L / Rs.9L ceiling; Executive: Rs.5L / Rs.15L ceiling; 25 months basic pay alternate limit
Amounts/Limits: Rs.1.5L to Rs.5L advance; Rs.6.75L to Rs.15L vehicle ceiling
Approval Authority: Director(F) / ED/HR / GM/O&M/HR
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/3341/2023 dated 06.09.2023

metadata.amounts_or_limits: Rs.1.5L to Rs.5L advance; Rs.6.75L to Rs.15L vehicle ceiling

chunks.title: Rule I.two_wheeler: Two-Wheeler Advance
chunks.content:
Rule I.two_wheeler — Two-Wheeler Advance (Chapter I: Vehicle Advance Rules)
Applies to: all grades
All grades: Rs.1.5 lakh or 10 months basic pay, whichever less. Vehicle cost ceiling: Rs.1.5 lakh.
Key points: Same for all grades; Rs.1.5 lakh or 10 months basic pay; Vehicle ceiling: Rs.1.5 lakh
Amounts/Limits: Rs.1.5 lakh or 10 months basic pay
Approval Authority: Director(F) / ED/HR / GM/O&M/HR
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/2349/2017 dated 03.04.2017

metadata.amounts_or_limits: Rs.1.5 lakh or 10 months basic pay

chunks.title: Rule J.2: MPA Eligibility and Frequency
chunks.content:
Rule J.2 — MPA Eligibility and Frequency (Chapter J: Multi-Purpose Advance (MPA) Rules)
Applies to: confirmed employees
Confirmed with 2.5 years service and >3 years remaining. Excludes temporary/ad-hoc/daily-rated/re-employed/contract. Contract @70% after regularization. Max 3 occasions career. 2-year gap between MPAs. Fresh cases prioritized.
Key points: Confirmed; 2.5 years service; 3 years remaining; Max 3 occasions career; 2-year gap after full repayment; Fresh cases get priority
Amounts/Limits: 2.5 years service; max 3 times career
Approval Authority: HOD/HR
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/538/2006, O.O. No. PP/1520/2012, O.O. No. PP/1782/2014

chunks.title: Rule J.3: MPA Amount
chunks.content:
Rule J.3 — MPA Amount (Chapter J: Multi-Purpose Advance (MPA) Rules)
Applies to: eligible employees
Maximum Rs.2,00,000 or 5 times basic pay, whichever is less.
Key points: Max Rs.2 lakh or 5x basic pay (lower of two)
Amounts/Limits: Max Rs.2,00,000 or 5x basic pay
Approval Authority: HOD/HR
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/2776/2018 dated 22.02.2019

chunks.title: Rule J.5: Interest and Repayment
chunks.content:
Rule J.5 — Interest and Repayment (Chapter J: Multi-Purpose Advance (MPA) Rules)
Applies to: all MPA borrowers
Interest: 7.5% simple. Principal: max 30 monthly installments. Interest: max 5 installments after principal. Total recovery including all deductions: max 50% of pay.
Key points: 7.5% simple interest; Principal: max 30 installments; Interest: max 5 installments; Total recovery cap: 50% of pay
Amounts/Limits: 7.5% interest; max 35 total installments; 50% pay cap
Approval Authority: Finance Department
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/538/2006

metadata.amounts_or_limits: 7.5% interest; max 35 total installments; 50% pay cap

chunks.title: Rule K.1: Applicability
chunks.content:
Rule K.1 — Applicability (Chapter K: Housing Allotment Rules)
Applies to: all regular employees including probationers
Rules apply to all DMRC residential accommodation. Employees occupy as licensees (not owners/tenants). No right to accommodation; subject to availability. DMRC retains ownership at all times.
Key points: Licensee — not owner/tenant; No right to accommodation; Subject to availability; Probationers included
Approval Authority: Estate Officer

chunks.title: Rule K.12: HRA, Subletting and Retention
chunks.content:
Rule K.12 — HRA, Subletting and Retention (Chapter K: Housing Allotment Rules)
Applies to: all quarter occupants
HRA not payable while in DMRC quarters; employee forgoes HRA. Subletting strictly prohibited = misconduct (B.5.24); damages (penal rent) charged. Must vacate within 1 month of transfer/superannuation/resignation. Unauthorized occupation after deadline: penal rent charged. Employees with own house at current station not eligible for quarters.
Key points: HRA forfeited while in DMRC quarters; Subletting = misconduct (B.5.24); Vacate within 1 month of transfer/superannuation; Penal rent for unauthorized occupation; Own house at station = not eligible
Amounts/Limits: Vacate within 1 month
Approval Authority: Estate Officer / HR

chunks.title: Rule L.2: Membership and Family
chunks.content:
Rule L.2 — Membership and Family (Chapter L: Staff Welfare Fund Rules)
Applies to: regular and contract employees on regular pay scale
Members: regular and contract on regular pay scale; excludes deputationist, PRCE, consultant, daily-wage, apprentices. Family: spouse, son (<25/not employed/married), unmarried unemployed daughter, dependent parents (income <15% basic or Rs.9000+DR whichever more).
Key points: Regular + contract on regular pay scale; Excludes deputation, PRCE, consultant; Same family definition as medical and LTC rules
Amounts/Limits: Parent income threshold: 15% basic or Rs.9000+DR
Approval Authority: Committee

applies_to: regular and contract employees on regular pay scale
metadata.amounts_or_limits: Parent income threshold: 15% basic or Rs.9000+DR

chunks.title: Rule L.5: Fund Sources
chunks.content:
Rule L.5 — Fund Sources (Chapter L: Staff Welfare Fund Rules)
Applies to: all members and DMRC
(a) Monthly member contributions; (b) Voluntary donations; (c) Interest, charity shows, fetes; (d) Annual DMRC matching contribution in April equal to members' total monthly contributions of previous year.
Key points: Monthly member contributions; DMRC matches previous year contributions annually in April; Voluntary donations accepted
Amounts/Limits: DMRC matches 100% of previous year member contributions
Approval Authority: Committee / MD

metadata.amounts_or_limits: DMRC matches 100% of previous year member contributions

chunks.title: Rule L.6: Welfare Activities
chunks.content:
Rule L.6 — Welfare Activities (Chapter L: Staff Welfare Fund Rules)
Applies to: all members and their families
General: marriage gift (member + first 2 children), child birth gift (first 2 children), disabled child grant, one-time grant to deceased member's family (no compassionate appointment cases), sports excellence award (state/national/intl. 1st/2nd/3rd). Education: 10th/12th grant, admission grant, Tablet PC (one daughter, non-supervisor), professional degree completion cash award for daughters. Recreation: clubs, sports, cultural, picnics, educational tours. Sickness: terminal illness aid, artificial limbs, funeral expenses.
Key points: Marriage and child birth gift: first 2 children; Sports award: state/national/intl. level; Tablet PC: one daughter, non-supervisor grade; Funeral expenses: member + spouse + children; Terminal illness financial assistance
Approval Authority: Committee → MD

chunks.title: Rule M.1: Applicability
chunks.content:
Rule M.1 — Applicability (Chapter M: Leave Travel Concession (LTC) Rules)
Applies to: regular employees, contractual on regular pay scale with 1 yr service, absorbed deputationists
LTC for regular employees and contractual on regular pay scales with min 1 year service. Absorbed deputationists eligible. Excludes casual employees, retired re-employed personnel, short-term contract.
Key points: Min 1 year continuous service; Regular + contractual on regular pay scale; Absorbed deputationists included; Retired re-employed: excluded
Amounts/Limits: Min 1 year service
Approval Authority: Competent Authority
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/1326/2011 dated 17.10.2011

applies_to: contractual on regular pay scale with 1 yr service

chunks.title: Rule M.4: LTC Types and Block Years
chunks.content:
Rule M.4 — LTC Types and Block Years (Chapter M: Leave Travel Concession (LTC) Rules)
Applies to: all eligible employees
Home Town LTC: once per 2-year block (direct/shortest route). All-India LTC: once per 4-year block (anywhere in India). If All-India not availed: extra Home Town LTC allowed in 4-year block. Min 6-month gap between LTCs. Block years: 2014-17, 2018-22, 2023-2025 etc. LTC only when on leave. Employees with same hometown and HQ not eligible for Hometown LTC.
Key points: Hometown: once per 2-year block; All-India: once per 4-year block; All-India not availed → extra Hometown LTC; Min 6-month gap between LTCs; Must be on leave; Same hometown + HQ = no Hometown LTC
Amounts/Limits: 1 Hometown per 2 years; 1 All-India per 4 years
Approval Authority: HOD / Competent Authority
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/1751/2014, O.O. No. PP/3236/2022, O.O. No. PP/1533/2012

metadata.amounts_or_limits: 1 Hometown per 2 years; 1 All-India per 4 years

chunks.title: Rule M.4.2.2: Special LTC — NER/J&K/A&N/Ladakh
chunks.content:
Rule M.4.2.2 — Special LTC — NER/J&K/A&N/Ladakh (Chapter M: Leave Travel Concession (LTC) Rules)
Applies to: all eligible employees
Air travel permitted to Non-Executives visiting NER, J&K, A&N, Ladakh against conversion of one Home Town LTC in 4-year block. Extended till 25.09.2024 per DoPT. Executives: entitled class. Non-executives: Economy class Air on specific sectors (Kolkata/Guwahati and NER; Kolkata/Chennai/Vizag and Port Blair; Delhi/Amritsar and J&K/Ladakh). Tickets: min 21 days advance via authorized agents (Balmer Lawrie, Ashok Travels & Tours, IRCTC). Settlement within 30 days; 10% p.a. interest on delay.
Key points: Non-executives can fly Economy to NER/J&K/A&N/Ladakh; Against 1 Hometown LTC conversion; Tickets: 21 days advance; authorized agents only; Settlement: 30 days after return; Extended till 25.09.2024
Amounts/Limits: Tickets: 21 days advance; Settle within 30 days
Approval Authority: Competent Authority / HOD
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/3234/2022 dated 14.12.2022, O.O. No. PP/3284/2023 dated 01.05.2023

metadata.amounts_or_limits: Tickets: 21 days advance; Settle within 30 days

chunks.title: Rule M.incidentals: Incidental Charges for All-India LTC
chunks.content:
Rule M.incidentals — Incidental Charges for All-India LTC (Chapter M: Leave Travel Concession (LTC) Rules)
Applies to: employees availing All-India LTC
Incidental charges applicable only for All-India LTC (not Hometown): Non-supervisors Rs.3750; Supervisors Rs.5250; Executives below HOD Rs.6000; HOD and above Rs.9000. Railway deputationists not entitled.
Key points: Non-supervisors: Rs.3750; Supervisors: Rs.5250; Executives below HOD: Rs.6000; HOD and above: Rs.9000; Only for All-India LTC; not for Hometown
Amounts/Limits: Rs.3750 to Rs.9000
Approval Authority: Finance Department
Office Orders: O.O. No. PP/1987/2015 dated 22.05.2015
